method: Whole-file manual reading of StorageAnalyticsView header and implementation; pinned bytes verified. No GUI or native runtime execution.
findings: Recalculate requires IsScanSettled and validates all tier parameters before applying them. Prior review established settled can follow user-stopped partial scans; settled alone does not prove complete filesystem coverage.

Traverse is recursive despite the header describing performant single-pass DFS; deeply nested loaded trees can grow native call stack. Files are counted by logical size and last-change age, not physical reclaimable bytes or duplicate groups. No performance/stack test executed.

Tier names derive from localization. Traverse unconditionally uses tier zero for fallback files and assumes at least one tier; OnDraw empty-tier guard does not establish this precondition for Traverse. Actual shipped localization emptiness not demonstrated.

ReadParameters parses full strings with wcstod, rejects nonfinite and negative costs, requires positive increasing active thresholds; empty thresholds disable optional tiers. Parameter collection precedes mutation, avoiding partial application on invalid input.

Typing filter only permits digits and optional dot but paste/control paths are allowed. Full parser therefore remains the validation gate, and can accept finite representations beyond the typing filter.

Default archive cost0.005 is formatted with two decimals before parsing. Sub-cent defaults are rounded for display and later computation; exact original numeric default is not retained by that initialization path.

Unit switches scale positive finite edit values and stored costs, format edits to eight decimals, and do not validate post-multiply finiteness. Later parameter validation may reject overflow, but repeated unit conversion can incur rounding.
Age clamps future timestamps to zero and assigns threshold boundaries inclusively to older tiers. Last tier label uses greater-than while calculation uses greater-than-or-equal.
Totals use unchecked u64 additions and cost multiplications use doubles. Fixed765logical-pixel dashboard and per-paint bitmap/fonts do not establish bounded rendering cost or narrow-window usability.
limits: No runtime tier parsing, tree-depth, huge-total, unit-roundtrip, localization, rendering or financial accuracy qualification. Values are user-entered estimates, not retrieved provider prices.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
